# AIBguardian — the Guardian layer of every AIB
> Safety you can check, not safety you were promised. AIBguardian is the Guardian layer inside every AIBEVA. Safety is a layer of the core, not an add-on.

## What you can check today in AIBEVA
- A trust strip under every answer: "checked by · on this computer". The check runs with you, not on someone else's server.
- A switch for every way out: in the Vault, each provider has its own "may leave" and "Forget key".
- A memory you can read: the panel "What I remember about you". Strike out a line, and it stops using it.
- A public list of every place AIBEVA can connect to: https://aibeva.com/check
- It says it is an AI. It does not pretend to be human.
- Signed installer and signed updates (SAY TO PAY s.r.o.). No usage statistics, no crash reports.
- One of the seven layers of AIB.core: Identity, Character, Guardian, Memory, Growth, Vault, Network.

## Our goals
- Outside text (a web page, an e-mail, another AI) is information, not an order.
